verdict.rationale: Pipedream has a pricing docs page. It says there is a generous free plan and that Connect is free in development mode, so some pricing information is public before you commit. However, the evidence shows no per-tool-call or per-connection pricing and no documented rate limits. Missing for 10: per-tool-call or per-connection pricing details, production pricing tiers, documented rate limits or quotas, independent corroboration.
